Subject: Pricing deck and short whiteboard — checking timing for Acme

Hi Taylor —

Great to connect earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: replace existing inference path for customer-facing chat with a lower-latency, lower-cost runtime while preserving fidelity.
- Current pain: 500–800ms P95 token latency, unpredictable bursts, and expensive scale on p95 loads.
- Success metrics: bring latency to ~200–300ms P95 and reduce per-token cost by ~30% while keeping outputs within current quality guardrails.

I attached a concise pricing deck and a preliminary estimate that maps to the traffic profile you shared. High-level suggestions are on slide 4 (dedicated pool + prefix cache + 8-bit quantized variant for the bulk of requests).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Quick walkthrough of the deck (15–20m) — we can whiteboard the routing/burst plan.
2) If that looks good, we’ll scope a short spike (2–3 days) to run a sample trace on your test workload.
3) Prepare a formal SOW and pricing hold (valid 30 days) if you want to move toward Dedicated.

Proposed slots: Mon 5/13 10–10:30am PT, Tue 5/14 2–2:30pm PT, Wed 5/15 11–11:30am PT. If none of these work, tell me a window that does.

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Deck_Acme_v1.pdf, Acme_Estimate_20290509.xlsx

Thanks — happy to walk through any of the assumptions on the cost model.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
